scampers across the ceiling and catches the cable, safely stowing it into an 
overhead compartment.

maintenance droid, arachnid in shape, and no bigger than a toaster.  It crawls

the computer woke up a colonist.  I'm SPDR-13, a maintenance robot, but the 
engineer-people call me Spider."

computer told me there's some kind of landing problem, and that the colonists 
are in danger.  Maybe we can help each other save them."
